text:
In the world teetering on the brink of destruction, the chosen one, Kai, was destined to harness the ancient magic to restore balance. The original tale ends with Kai merging his spirit with the magic, becoming one with it and saving the world, but at the cost of his human existence. Alternative Ending: Instead of dissolving into the ether, Kai discovers that the ancient magic requires a vessel, not a sacrifice. He channels the overwhelming power through his own body, enduring immense pain but retaining his consciousness. The magic stabilizes, not by consuming him, but by binding to his will. Kai survives, physically scarred but alive, and becomes the new guardian of the balance, no longer just a chosen one, but a living bridge between humanity and the arcane forces he once feared.

The capital of France is Paris.
